title: Build a great camera experience for iPhone Duo
description: Discover how to leverage the outer and inner cameras on iPhone Duo. Explore the Virtual Front Camera, and find out how to use the direction coordinator to switch between cameras and update your UI as people open and close iPhone Duo. Learn best practices for handling preview aspect ratios, positioning, and rotation to deliver a seamless capture experience.

codeSnippets.title: Understand AVCaptureDevicePosition
Initialize a direction coordinator
codeSnippets.code:
directionCoordinator = AVCaptureDeviceDirectionCoordinator(
    view: view,
    deviceTypes: [
        .builtInOuterUltraWideCamera,
        .builtInInnerUltraWideCamera,
        .builtInDualWideCamera,
    ],
    changeHandler: { [weak self] map in
        self?.updateCameraSession(map)
    }
)
